verdict.rationale: ReadMe documents a dedicated data-export path: docs can be exported as files or as PDF from the Branch menu, plus via tooling and the API. Bi-directional sync keeps Markdown/MDX and OpenAPI content in your own GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket repo, and a CLI (rdme), the ReadMe API and a metrics API offer programmatic access. A community report of a team moving from ReadMe to Docusaurus suggests leaving is practical. Missing for 10: evidence that non-content data (analytics, API logs, users/settings) is fully exportable; detail on how portable ReadMe-specific MDX components are; independent hands-on corroboration of the export process itself.
